name: RECOVEROP-the-password-set-instead
note: The operator would know the player's password, the lost code would still be the only code, and the game's recovery would refuse the new one.

name: RECOVEROP-the-pretty-code-hashed
note: recover hashes the canonical code (no dashes), so a hash of the dashed one never matches: a code that cannot be used.

name: RECOVEROP-the-handle-as-typed
note: handle_lc is folded; 'TWODDLE' typed into the workflow would match no row.

name: RECOVEROP-the-quote-not-doubled
note: A username may carry a quote, and without doubling it ends the string: a syntax error, or SQL a username wrote.

name: RECOVEROP-the-hash-form-unchecked
note: atob skips whitespace, so a hash with a space pasted into it would be stored as something the tool never wrote.

name: RECOVEROP-the-workflow-changes-none-and-passes
note: A misspelled username changes no row, and a green run would tell the operator the code was set.

name: RECOVEROP-an-input-spliced-into-a-run-line
note: An input pasted into a run: line is a shell command whoever runs the workflow can type.
